ideas.pitch: Real-time coastal erosion and marine anomaly forecasting platform utilizing time-series modeling and localized computer vision feeds.
ideas.title: WaveGuard AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a rigorous statistical and predictive modeling approach similar to past winning forecasting projects, appealing to judges looking for hard data science rather than basic wrappers.

ideas.pitch: Satellite imagery and geospatial monitoring dashboard for tracking maritime and coastal industrial land use violations.
ideas.title: AquaCompliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the architecture of proven geospatial monitoring winners, presenting complex satellite data in an easily digestible compliance interface for enterprise or municipal judges.

ideas.pitch: Autonomous AI agent workflow marketplace with secure smart contract milestone escrow payments for marine research grants.
ideas.title: HydroEscrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines autonomous execution agents with secure escrow rails, mirroring the technical depth of top-tier hackathon winners in the decentralized agent space.

ideas.pitch: Personalized nutritional and meal-planning assistant tailored specifically for maritime crew members and offshore workers with limited pantry inventory.
ideas.title: NutriWave
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on a hyper-specific, localized niche use case that directly targets lifestyle optimization, a proven category among recent 24-hour hackathon champions.

ideas.pitch: Graph intelligence and risk-scoring engine designed to detect illicit maritime trade and suspicious vessel financing transactions.
ideas.title: TideGraph AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Implements advanced graph analytics and explainable machine learning scoring, satisfying the high technical bar set by previous financial crime and compliance hackathon winners.
